title: AFCAT 02/2026 Admit Card
vacancyDetails: AFCAT 02/2026 for Flying Branch and Ground Duty (Technical/Non-Technical) courses
qualification: Graduation / engineering degree as per branch-wise AFCAT 02/2026 eligibility
applicationFee: ₹550 + 18% GST as per AFCAT fee structure
selectionProcess: AFCAT Online Exam → AFSB Interview → Medical
documentsRequired: Email ID / password for AFCAT login; printed admit card and photo ID for exam
howToApply:
1. Visit https://afcat.edcil.co.in/
2. Login with the registered email and password
3. Download the AFCAT 02/2026 admit card
4. Print and verify the centre, date, shift and photograph
5. Carry the admit card and a valid photo ID to the exam
shortDescription: AFCAT 02/2026 Admit Card was released on 05 August 2026 for the examination scheduled on 08 August 2026. Download it from the official AFCAT portal.
content:
The Indian Air Force released the AFCAT 02/2026 Admit Card on 05 August 2026. The AFCAT 02/2026 examination was scheduled for 08 August 2026.

Use the official AFCAT portal to download the hall ticket and verify the exam centre, shift, reporting time and photograph.
